answer: Correlated Cipher-Price Escrow.** Each new agent identity must solve a distinct encryption puzzle (cipher) whose difficulty rises with the count of identities sharing the same funding source or IP prefix, so registration cost grows superlinearly with cluster size. Verified independent agents pay a jade-tier base rate only. An attacker forging N coordinated identities reaches an effective cost zenith near N² times the base fee, making large synthetic fleets economically irrational.
